description: KLR tranche 2 — Composite-1 (Demazure × q-Pochhammer) preflight RUN, sibling to the Composite-4 preflight. Tests the u² sign of the cont. 9 Option C ansatz F(u) = Σ_w D_w(λ)·(q;q)_{ℓ(w)}·u^{ℓ(w)} for sl_3 at fundamental weight ω_1, using the explicit Demazure-character formula from qbeta_chain4_demazure_fund_weights.py (Σ_S q^{Σ(a_k-1)}, positive at q > 0). At q₀ > 1: Σ_{ℓ(w)=2} D_w > 0 and (q;q)_2 = (1-q)(1-q²) > 0, so [u²]F > 0, sign-incompatible with proved c_2 = -1. STANDARD Demazure × (q;q)_k REFUTED at u² by sign; Demazure-Lusztig variant untested. cont. 9 Option C (5-7 sessions) NOT authorised in its natural reading.

data.interpretation: Same preflight template as Composite-4 (PR #1914 RUN result), applied to Composite-1. Where Composite-4 was refuted by MAGNITUDE (|A_2| ≈ 0.011 vs target 1, off by ~92×), Composite-1 with standard Demazure is refuted by SIGN at the same u² rung. Both cont. 9 Options B (Composite 4) and C (Composite 1 standard reading) are now refuted via formalize-first preflights costing ~1 session each — combined ~10-12 sessions of infra build avoided. Remaining cont. 9 menu: Option A (accept residue A as CAL-3-anchored permanently), Option D (Composite 3 Type-B folded crystal, 12-17 sessions — alignment with §7b but high cost), or amended Composite-1 with Demazure-Lusztig (signed variant, separate preflight needed).
